title: The label and contents of Moon's Miracle Tonic
summary: The dollar tonic claimed to cure everything but was grenadine, Epsom salts and alcohol, and Moon cleared it with local sheriffs.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What did the medicine have on it? What did it say on it?

"Doc Moon's Miracle Tonic. Will Cure Anything. It's been tested by the United States Government. It will cure anything." And they had a long list of... It will cure tuberculosis, whooping cough, pneumonia, takes corns off your feet.
How much did this sell for? Do you remember?
Mostly all of the medicine shows, that was your standard price, so you ain't got no problem making change. Everybody got a dollar. No change.
Did you ever find out what would be in this?
Well, we used to bottle it on... He claimed he had secret ingredients. "You boys ain't gonna never see none of this stuff, because this is my secret to long life."
Yeah. And he had all of this, which I am sure was really grenadine syrup and a lot of Epsom salts -- because it was a laxative, you know. This grenadine syrup
was red, you see, and it made nice pretty color, and it tasted pretty good. Then you had quite a bit of alcohol in it, I'll tell you that.

Yes, sir. I don't know how he got hold of that alcohol, but he would get it -- because there was some way these guys would get a hold of that thing. But a lot of these towns didn't allow medicine shows.
Because they knew a lot of them was phony. But Doc Moon would get there first and talk to the Sheriff, and give him his little...
